schema: temporal ledger: entity = one registry entry (a firm at a court); entity.slices[] = events {as_of (volume year), date, event, source, name, attrs, provenance{project, stem, group_id, issue}, seq}; edges[] = typed entity→entity links (transfer / successor / duplicate_of)
spine: opaque sequential ids minted by Dedust (id_scheme) from the registry gazette (Központi Értesítő); identity is the registering court + the firm as entered; renames keep the entry, a transfer or transformation is a new entry with an edge

normalize.note: legal-form and status words dropped wherever they occur, in queries and in entity names/aliases, before matching; edit here, never in code
